title: Core Specialty Insurance Launches IPO to Enable Shareholder Divestment
digest: Core Specialty Insurance has initiated an IPO plan to facilitate the sale of shares to existing shareholders, according to a November 19, 2026 report from Seeking Alpha. The action aims to provide liquidity for current investors while expanding the company's capital base through public market listing. No further details on IPO structure, valuation, or timeline have been disclosed in the current reporting.
